# vergeio_network (Resource)

Network or Vnet resource in VergeIO

## Example Usage

```terraform



# Create Network with all parameters

resource "vergeio_network" "example" {
  name                 = "Example Net"
  enabled              = true
  vnet_default_gateway = 3
  network              = "192.168.0.0/24"
  dhcp_enabled         = true
  dhcp_sequential      = true
  dynamic_dhcp         = true
  dhcp_start           = "192.168.0.2"
  dhcp_stop            = "192.168.0.200"
  on_power_loss        = "power_on"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique network name

### Optional

- `bond_interfaces_args` (List of Number) Bonding interfaces arguments
- `dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Is DHCP enabled
- `dhcp_sequential` (Boolean) Is DHCP sequential
- `dhcp_start` (String) DHCP start address
- `dhcp_stop` (String) DHCP stop address
- `dynamic_dhcp` (Boolean) Is DHCP dynamic
- `enable_bonding` (Boolean) Enable bonding
- `enabled` (Boolean) Network state
- `interface_vnet` (Number) Key/ID of the physical network
- `ipaddress` (String) IP address assigned to network
- `ipaddress_type` (String) IP address type of the vnet
- `layer2_id` (Number) VLAN ID
- `layer2_type` (String) Layer2 type of the vnet
- `mtu` (Number) Network MTU
- `network` (String) Network address
- `on_power_loss` (String) What to do on power loss
- `powerstate` (String) Power state of the network
- `type` (String) Type of Network
- `vnet_default_gateway` (Number) Vnet default gateway

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Network id (returned as the key) in VergeIO
